output.reason: The changelog [ev-acec48f57273] says only that Kafka node certificates are now stored in separate Secrets, one Secret per pod. It does not say that anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated. The release's upgrade notes ask operators to act on other changes ([ev-4c2676e4665a], [ev-a6197708b375], [ev-4fdefdd841ec], [ev-2dffc916b09a]) but say nothing about this one. So a low-severity behavior-change that should be reviewed is the strongest consequence the evidence supports, and nothing supports a failure kind.
